claim: The official brief asks for an agentic EdTech product for regional language and geography
allowable_wording: The brief asks for an education product whose core plans, decides, uses tools and acts toward a learning goal.
prohibited_wording: The brief requires a chatbot / a specific framework / Kui support.

claim: Teams may choose their own user
allowable_wording: The brief lets teams choose a different user; we chose an Odia-medium Class 10 learner.
prohibited_wording: We built the official Sunita case.

claim: The event page lists weights 30/20/20/30 and stages 30%/70%; the problem PDF lists core and bonus criteria; the rules page lists a third set
allowable_wording: The public pages give three different criteria lists; we cite the one we are quoting.
prohibited_wording: "The rubric is X" without naming the page; blending the three lists.

claim: The public pages are inconsistent about the mid-evaluation and event hours
allowable_wording: We will use the slot the organisers assign us.
prohibited_wording: "Our slot is 4 PM on Day 1" unless assigned in writing.

claim: Rule 4.1: all code must be built during competition hours
allowable_wording: Most of the code was built on 12-13 Oct 2026 with AI assistance, before the event; the team reports that the organisers allowed early work (team-reported; no saved message is in the repository).
prohibited_wording: "Built during the hackathon." / "The organisers approved this in writing" without a document.

claim: Pathasetu targets an Odia-medium Class 10 learner studying Electricity for board preparation
allowable_wording: The prototype is designed for an Odia-medium Class 10 learner and covers eight Electricity questions.
prohibited_wording: Covers the BSE Odisha syllabus." / "Supports all grades / subjects.

claim: "Geography" means the learner's access context, not the school subject
allowable_wording: By geography we mean weak signal and shared devices, not the Geography subject.
prohibited_wording: Adapts to the learner's region.

claim: Class 10 and Electricity are a scoping choice
allowable_wording: We scoped to one chapter so every wrong option could carry a named misconception.
prohibited_wording: Electricity is the biggest pain point.

claim: No user research or learner has used the app
allowable_wording: No real learner has used it and we have no user research.
prohibited_wording: Any testimonial, usage figure or persona presented as real.

claim: The loop observes state, proposes a diagnosis, validates it, updates state, plans the next question and records a trace
allowable_wording: A tested, deterministic agentic workflow with a bounded proposer slot.
prohibited_wording: Autonomous agent." / "Multi-agent system.

claim: The workflow is deterministic and is not multi-agent
allowable_wording: A deterministic workflow, not autonomous and not multi-agent.
prohibited_wording: "Multi-agent", "swarm", "autonomous agents".

claim: No agent framework or npm dependency is used
status: implemented; unit-tested (package declarations checked on 13 Oct 2026)
allowable_wording: There are no npm dependencies and no agent framework.
prohibited_wording: Built with LangChain / CrewAI / AutoGen / React / Express.

claim: The default provider is a mock rule that does not read free text
allowable_wording: In the demo the diagnosis step is an option-linked rule and says so on screen.
prohibited_wording: AI-powered diagnosis." / "It understands the student's explanation.

claim: The Groq adapter exists and has only run against a fake server
status: implemented; unit-tested (fake server only); not tested (live-API)
allowable_wording: An optional Groq adapter exists; no live request has been made.
prohibited_wording: Powered by Groq / GPT-OSS." / "Live model results.

claim: Live Groq smoke and evaluation are blocked for lack of credentials
allowable_wording: The live run is BLOCKED: credentials were not configured.
prohibited_wording: Smoke test passed." / "We evaluated the model.

claim: A model cannot write learner state directly; every diagnosis is validated and stored as provisional
allowable_wording: Model output is only a proposal that a fixed validator must accept; results stay provisional.
prohibited_wording: The system confirms mastery." / "Guarantees correct diagnoses.

claim: The planner's confirmed-gap term is never set from the app (re-checks are untrusted)
allowable_wording: The next question is chosen by concept focus and prior attempts; confirmed gaps are not recorded automatically.
prohibited_wording: Tracks the learner's confirmed gaps." / "Personalised mastery model.

claim: Answers are saved on the device, queued offline, and re-checked on reconnect, in headless Chromium
allowable_wording: The learning loop, saved answers and Bridge Practice work with the network off; the server check waits. Tested in headless Chromium; phones not yet tested.
prohibited_wording: Fully offline." / "Works offline on phones.

claim: Offline behaviour on Galaxy S23, S25, S25 FE and iPhone 16
allowable_wording: Phone tests are planned and not yet run.
prohibited_wording: Tested on Galaxy / iPhone." / "Works on all phones.

claim: Retries are bounded: five automatic attempts with growing delay, then paused with Retry now
allowable_wording: A stalled provider cannot freeze the queue; after five tries it pauses and the answer stays safe.
prohibited_wording: Guaranteed delivery." / "Self-healing.

claim: Corrupt or partly corrupt saved state is repaired and the unreadable copy is kept
allowable_wording: Damaged saved state is repaired where possible and never silently deleted.
prohibited_wording: Cannot lose data." / "Data is always saved.

claim: Storage is best effort; the app says when progress is not being saved
allowable_wording: The app reports honestly whether progress is saved and never promises retention.
prohibited_wording: Your progress is always kept.

claim: A second tab is read-only (Web Locks)
allowable_wording: A second tab is read-only so two tabs cannot overwrite each other.
prohibited_wording: Syncs between devices.

claim: Bridge Practice runs locally from the pack's mappings with no network or model
allowable_wording: A local matching exercise built only from draft mappings in the pack; correct means consistent with the pack.
prohibited_wording: Teaches correct translations." / "Teacher-verified terms.

claim: All eight items, Odia wording and bridge mappings are unreviewed drafts
allowable_wording: All content and Odia wording are AI-assisted drafts awaiting teacher review.
prohibited_wording: "Reviewed", "approved", "verified", "accurate Odia".

claim: No teacher review took place in this iteration
allowable_wording: The reviewer step is prepared and BLOCKED: no reviewer was available.
prohibited_wording: Any reviewer name, date or approval that was not recorded by the reviewer.

claim: Kui, voice input/output and transliteration are not implemented; there is no language switch
allowable_wording: Today: English questions with Odia draft text beside them and a term bridge. No Kui, no voice.
prohibited_wording: Supports Kui / tribal languages / voice / Indic languages.

claim: Typed explanations are sent to the Pathasetu server on re-check; to Groq only if Groq is configured
allowable_wording: State and the queue are stored locally when browser storage works; the typed reason is sent to the Pathasetu server on each re-check and to the hosted model only if one is configured; the trace export omits it.
prohibited_wording: No data leaves the device." / "Nothing is sent anywhere." / "Saves everything on the phone.

claim: There is no server-side learner database or account system
allowable_wording: The server keeps no learner data; there are no accounts.
prohibited_wording: GDPR / child-privacy compliant.

claim: Demo access control: strong code, failed-attempt window, origin allow-list, preflight
allowable_wording: Demo-grade protection for a short-lived private demo.
prohibited_wording: Production secure." / "Secure authentication.

claim: Security headers and refusal of private paths
allowable_wording: Strict content-security headers and private paths are refused by our own tests.
prohibited_wording: Security audited / penetration tested.

claim: No independent security review has been done
allowable_wording: No independent security review yet.
prohibited_wording: "Secure", "hardened", "pen-tested".

claim: No real HTTPS tunnel or host has been run
allowable_wording: The HTTPS path is prepared and BLOCKED; nothing is deployed.
prohibited_wording: Deployed." / "Live at <address>.

claim: Unit test count 207 in the Iteration 6 final run (198 at Iteration 5; 182 at the Iteration 4 baseline)
allowable_wording: 207 of 207 unit tests passed in our build sandbox; the earlier counts are history.
prohibited_wording: Quoting the number without the environment; "all tests pass on all machines".

claim: Headless browser results: capture 19/19, e2e 100/100, accessibility 462 checks with 0 failed
allowable_wording: 100 browser checks and 462 automated accessibility checks passed in headless Chromium; browser navigation was blocked on the team's managed machine, so these are not reproduced there.
prohibited_wording: Tested on mobile." / "Accessible." / "WCAG compliant.

claim: On the team's managed machine the browser tests were blocked by browser policy
allowable_wording: On our managed laptop, browser tests were blocked by policy; we record them as BLOCKED.
prohibited_wording: "They pass on every machine." / Treating BLOCKED as a pass.

claim: Automated accessibility checks are not screen-reader tests
allowable_wording: Passes our automated checks in emulated viewports; TalkBack and VoiceOver not tested.
prohibited_wording: Screen-reader accessible." / "Accessible to visually impaired learners.

claim: Evaluation: 47 team-authored English cases; compatibility 47/47; agreement 34/47 (72%); abstained on 2 of 12 unclear cases
status: measured result (rule on synthetic English, unreviewed labels)
allowable_wording: On 47 English cases we wrote, the demo rule agreed with our own labels 34 times and abstained on 2 of 12 unclear cases.
prohibited_wording: 72% accuracy." / "Odia accuracy." / "Model accuracy.

claim: No Odia or Roman-Odia evaluation case exists; no live model was evaluated
allowable_wording: Odia and Roman-Odia evaluation is not done; the template has 24 blank rows for a reviewer.
prohibited_wording: Any Odia performance figure.

claim: No learning benefit has been measured
allowable_wording: Learning impact is unmeasured; here is how we would measure it.
prohibited_wording: "Improves marks", "proven learning gains", "educationally validated".

claim: Low-end phone support is untested
allowable_wording: We have tested on no phone of any class yet.
prohibited_wording: Runs on low-end phones." / "Low-end tested.

claim: The app is small and has no libraries (about 140 KB of its own files, uncompressed, no server compression)
status: measured result (file sizes on 13 Oct 2026); unknown (mobile data use)
allowable_wording: Its own files are about 140 KB uncompressed; real data use is not measured.
prohibited_wording: Uses very little data." / "Low-data tested.

claim: Shared phone with several learners is not supported (one local session record, no profiles)
allowable_wording: One device, one local session record today; learner profiles are not built; the app does not safely separate several learners.
prohibited_wording: Supports shared family phones.

claim: The answer key is present in the browser by design
allowable_wording: It is practice software; the browser holds the answer key so it works offline.
prohibited_wording: Secure assessment.

claim: Provenance: AI-assisted build; every commit is authored as the AI-assisted build; iteration 3 history was rebuilt and disclosed
allowable_wording: AI-assisted from the first version; history is preserved and disclosed.
prohibited_wording: Written entirely by the team." / "Built during the event.

claim: Provider eligibility under the event wording
allowable_wording: The event page permits external open-source LLM APIs; the team reports an organiser clarification that all APIs are allowed (team-reported). No live Groq call has been made.
prohibited_wording: The rules allow Groq (as if the event page said so).

claim: Mid-evaluation scope: commit audit, working workflow demo, architecture
allowable_wording: The checkpoint covers the repository history, a working workflow and the architecture.
prohibited_wording: The checkpoint is judged on the pitch deck.

claim: The team's intended meaning of Pathasetu is a bridge for learning between languages
allowable_wording: Our intended meaning for Pathasetu is a bridge for learning between languages; we are not claiming a formally verified literal translation.
prohibited_wording: A dictionary translation or authoritative etymology.

claim: The footer and answer-box hint name the provider the server reports (mock or configured Groq with model and an accuracy-unvalidated warning)
status: implemented; unit-tested; browser-tested (stubbed server; no live call)
allowable_wording: With a Groq-configured server the screen says CONFIGURED · GROQ · model · ACCURACY UNVALIDATED; by default it says MOCK PROVIDER · DEMO RULES · NO LIVE AI.
prohibited_wording: The app is LLM-powered (no live request has been made).

claim: Current result counts come from one marker in BUILD_STATUS and are checked against the saved final evidence
allowable_wording: The pitch quotes the same figures as BUILD_STATUS; older figures are labelled baseline.
prohibited_wording: Quoting 182 or 198 as the current count.
